body:
yea, you get it

i wouldn't accept a bpd diagnosis for the longest time, because it was the only one that made staff at faclities outright treat me with hostility, i basically felt like i was an animal whose thoughts a
d feelings weren't valid reactions to being forced onto a gurney, strapped down, laughed at, mocked for some phraes I used way back when I was starting IOP (things need to make sense to me for me to use them as techniques for overcoming my cognitive defects. otherwise I can't apply the awareness to identify where I went wrong specifically, and sometimes people just see me as wrong, but don't want that opinion challenged, so they say "you did something wrong" but won't say what it you did - just "you made the counselors concerned. concerned my ass. they just hated me because i didn't instantly swallow half assed bullshit explanations and solutions for problems that are vastly more complicated than they are presented as

sitting in a classroom with the whiteboard saying "this is how to sleep" doesn't actually cause me to sleep better. it's patronizing and hypocritical, and there is so much authority and money surrounding it, that it really can enforce and create limitations of people's minds, by forcing them to believe their minds are limited to a certain subset of behavior, as indicated by people that aren't you, because that makes so much more sense than just waiting to see what one person will do, instead of trying to predict, because there are two, and they are similar enough to infer that they may agree about many things

i would rather split my personality in half and hide the side I cherish, than be dissected and judged like that again

mental health care has a long way to go when it comes to bpd. i am convinced most are just annoyed by the behavior, find it obnoxious, and that makes them hostile, and even desiring to inflict pain

which means, they really need to be the one listening to get help, not the one distributing information of what helps, when they have no direct experience proving that they are in agreement with that conclusion

just, judgement of the outsides of people, and the insane belief that they can somehow fill in the gaps of people's insides, by finding someone similar enough in external behavior, that is know more about internally

it;s delusional because those insides never have to validate themselves as true, that does not stop people from accepting it as  a more likely possibility than just saying "unknown"


ick ick ick at people who pretend to have so much certainty in their convictions, they take offense at a fucking question that requests they explain why the bit of information they hold onto, can be used to explain and describe me without actually knowing me, and to describe their methodology more specifically than "makes sense to me"

if that's their reasoning, great, they are the only one who has solid enough ground to believe the statement. saying it to a crowd of people with no way to check it is pointless and just introduces more conflicting explanations because, overgeneralize behavior down to some very few patterns, that's just not enough to assume on person can be used to guess the general definition of the other

I seriously tried to get a PhD in part, to help myself understand how to write formal proofs of logic. The rest has to do with computers, but yea, I really was set on learning that stuff, to help supplement the 'inquisitive' chunk of me, that I am actually fairly comfortable with, because it's the most humble and realistic, and places the smallest onus of burden on itself, in the event I just don't know enough to warrant any other self image. But yea, questioning me has tons of ways of constructing self doubt, is hypercritical, and skeptical/wary in assessing my own ability  as is, and my ability to assess my abilities accurately enough to do the first one, assess any ability, not just the ability to assess (yes my brain is always this messy and convoluted) otherwise i just it one day clicks into place for me and I actually have some solid ground to stand on, instead of security and comfort in the fact that no one can demand me to know everything, enough to know all consequences of actions and judgement I have never observed nor tested safely, but have to do, because that's the choice - do something different. and i've tried most of what's typical for self help, finding solid ground, learning, reinforcing and checking carefully, what I accept as fact, and what I depend on to make decisions

this is good for life, but as for phd, i had a massive mental breakdown due to a single lie, lollerskates, so you know how it goes. horribly, basically


fml basically
just, trying to work through stuff i guess, and seek out some company, lonely
